Creates the ItemPrice aggregate for a catalogue item that exists in the local CatalogItemView (fed by offer-availability events). The initial list price is set here; sale windows are scheduled separately. An id outside 1-64 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (starting with a letter or digit) is 422 validation-failed.
